picks.headline: iPhone 18 Pro Launching on September 18 With These 10 New Features
picks.excerpt: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro pairs the 2nm A20 Pro and its 32-core Neural Engine with a variable-aperture 48MP camera, shipping with iOS 27 and the rebuilt Siri AI. Pre-orders open September 12.
picks.rationale: Pre-orders open today and the 32-core Neural Engine plus variable-aperture camera set the on-device AI baseline every mobile designer will target next year.

picks.headline: Does Apple's Live Rewind really turn the Apple Watch into a 'mass surveillance device'?
picks.excerpt: Apple's new Live Rewind feature has the Apple Watch continuously buffering sensor data on-device, and TechRadar breaks down how the privacy tech behind it actually works.
picks.rationale: The freshest item in the pool and a clean case study in how always-on sensing has to be explained to users — directly useful for anyone designing ambient AI features.

picks.headline: First Clear Visuals Of Meta's Project Phoenix Headset Found In Quest Firmware
picks.excerpt: Quest firmware has surfaced the first clear images of Meta's Project Phoenix: a slim headset with glasses-style nose pads tethered to a compute puck, ahead of Connect 2026.
picks.rationale: First real look at Meta's puck-tethered slim headset — the industrial-design direction XR teams will be benchmarking against right before Connect.

picks.headline: Google brings Gemini for desktop app to Windows
picks.excerpt: After April's macOS debut, Google's native Gemini desktop app comes to Windows with an Alt + Space shortcut, putting the assistant a keystroke away on PCs.
picks.rationale: A native Alt+Space assistant on Windows changes the default AI entry point for the majority of design teams that are not on Mac.

picks.headline: Atlas promises 'a new generation of brain wearable' with its first neural tracker
picks.excerpt: The $499 Atlas 1.0 Pioneer Edition is a behind-the-ear neural tracker that reads brain signals to score stress, attention and energy. The first pre-order batch sold out immediately.
picks.rationale: A $499 consumer EEG wearable that sold out on day one opens attention and stress as a new input signal for product design.
